scripts.dev: MIMI_HOME="${MIMI_HOME:-$PWD/.dev}" concurrently --kill-others --names daemon,app --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "pnpm dev:daemon" "pnpm dev:app"
scripts.dev:daemon: MIMI_HOME="${MIMI_HOME:-$PWD/.dev}" MIMI_PORT="${MIMI_PORT:-7438}" cargo run -p mimi-core --bin mimid
scripts.dev:app: MIMI_HOME="${MIMI_HOME:-$PWD/.dev}" MIMI_DAEMON=external pnpm --filter @mimi/desktop tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.web: pnpm build && MIMI_HOME="${MIMI_HOME:-$PWD/.dev}" cargo run -q -p mimi-cli -- open
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && pnpm typecheck
